mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a quarter signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% in three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for three consecutive months signals a supportive monetary environment, which encourages risk-taking and boosts equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS decreases by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 3% in a month, it signals a broad-based increase in demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 3% in a month.
